name: noverify
description: Shows the reports of the NoVerify PHP linter in the Problems panel.

noverify.executable.markdownDescription: The noverify binary: a path or a name. A name is looked for in the `PATH`, then in `$GOBIN`, `$GOPATH/bin` and `~/go/bin`.

noverify.configFiles.markdownDescription: The paths of the config file (`noverify check -c`) relative to a directory. The extension looks for them in the directory of the saved file and then in its parents, so the config of a module is found from any file of the module.

noverify.runOnSave.description: Check the module when a PHP file is saved.

noverify.runOnOpen.description: Check the module when its first PHP file is opened.

enumDescriptions: Show everything: errors, warnings and the "maybe" notices.
noverify.minimumLevel.description: The lowest level of the reports that are shown.

noverify.extraArgs.markdownDescription: Extra arguments of `noverify check`, for example `["--exclude-checks", "unused"]`.

noverify.explorerDecorations.markdownDescription: Show the number of the NoVerify reports on the files and folders in the file explorer (a folder has the sum of its files). More than 99 is shown as `∞`, the exact number is in the tooltip.

noverify.timeout.description: The time limit of a check, seconds.
